source: names, constraints (type, enum, minimum, maximum, default, items) and descriptions: the tools/list of @blockchainacademics/mcp 0.6.4 at bca-mcp-ts release/0.6.4 commit 92f4275 (SDK 1.32.2), dumped over stdio from a clean build with no key.

descriptions.search_news: Full text search across 3,800+ editorial crypto articles from the Blockchain Academics corpus. Each hit carries title, summary, source, publish date, topics, tickers and entity slugs, with the article as its citation. Filter by entity, ticker, topic or a since date, and page with offset. Covers recent crypto events, projects, tokens, regulation, protocols and people. Answers unseeded (meta.status) when nothing matches. Works without an API key.
descriptions.get_entity: Fetch a BCA entity dossier (chain, project, person or ticker): name, kind, ticker, chain, website and X handle, summary when there is one, mention count and first and last mention dates. Takes exactly one of slug or ticker. Aliases in slug form resolve to the canonical entity ('cz' to changpeng-zhao, 'maker' to makerdao) and the answer names the alias in resolved_from_alias. The ticker form returns every entity that matches the ticker (the ticker dossier and the chain or project it maps to) and needs an API key; the slug form works without one. Many dossiers are still thin: meta.status partial, with meta.diagnostic.missing naming what is absent (summary, mentions). Applies to 'what is X' and 'who is X' questions, including names found by search_news.
descriptions.get_explainer: Fetch BCA Academy material: 38 lessons across 8 courses covering crypto fundamentals, DeFi, trading, regulation and onchain security. Takes exactly one of slug or topic. A course slug returns the course and its lesson index; a lesson slug returns that lesson with its full text (body_md); an unknown slug returns the closest lesson as partial. A topic returns the courses tagged with it, or else the top matching lessons with their text. Applies to requests to explain a crypto concept, such as 'explain liquidity pools' or 'what is DeFi'. Works without an API key.
descriptions.get_article: Fetch one BCA article by slug: title, summary, full text (body_md), author, source, publish date, topics, tickers and entity slugs, with the article as its citation. This is the full text behind a search_news hit. An unknown slug is an error (HTTP 404). Works without an API key.
descriptions.list_entity_mentions: Timeline of BCA article mentions for an entity (slug or alias), newest first: article slug, title and source URL, publish date, sentiment score and bucket, mentions in the article and a context snippet. Page with offset. Shows how coverage of a chain, project, person or ticker changed over time. Answers unseeded when no public article mentions the entity yet; an unknown entity is an error (HTTP 404).
descriptions.list_topics: Browse the BCA topic taxonomy: regulation, defi, nft, layer-2, bitcoin, ethereum, solana, stablecoins, rwa and ai-agents. Each topic comes with its live article count and child topics, and its slug is a topic filter value for search_news.
descriptions.get_as_of_snapshot: Time-travel query: the article corpus as it stood at a past date, meaning only the articles BCA had ingested by as_of, optionally narrowed by a search query and an entity slug. Useful for backtesting and audit trails. Free, and works without an API key. Answers unseeded when nothing matches.
descriptions.get_price: Spot price, 24h change, market cap and 24h volume for up to 50 tokens, via CoinGecko. Takes CoinGecko ids such as 'bitcoin' or 'ethereum' (not exchange tickers), comma separated, and an optional quote currency vs (default usd). Works without an API key.
descriptions.get_ohlc: OHLC candles ([timestamp, open, high, low, close]) for one token from CoinGecko, over 1 to 365 days. Starter tier. Useful for technical-setup agents and backtesting.
descriptions.get_market_overview: Top tokens by market cap from CoinGecko (limit, default 20, up to 100): price, market cap, 24h volume and the 1h, 24h and 7d price change. Gives context for the whole market: its direction and the biggest movers. Works without an API key.
descriptions.get_pair_data: DEX pair analytics from DexScreener: liquidity, 24h volume, price and pair age, with the raw DexScreener pair fields. Starter tier.
descriptions.get_wallet_profile: Wallet summary: native balance (in wei and in the chain coin, for example ETH) and up to 25 token holdings. EVM holdings are the net of the newest 1,000 token transfers with likely spam dropped (partial when older history exists); Solana holdings are current SPL balances. No address labels. Starter tier.
descriptions.get_tx: Decode one transaction: block, sender, receiver, value, gas and fee, status, and the receipt logs with ERC-20 and ERC-721 transfers decoded (EVM via Etherscan; Solana via Helius). Partial while the receipt is not available; an unknown hash is an error (HTTP 404). Starter tier.
descriptions.get_token_holders: Top holders of an ERC-20 token with balance and share of supply, via Etherscan, for holder concentration and risk analysis. EVM chains only, Pro tier. Etherscan serves holder lists on its paid plan only, so this usually answers partial today (meta.diagnostic names the upstream error).
descriptions.get_defi_protocol: Compact DefiLlama snapshot of a DeFi protocol: TVL in total and per chain, 1d, 7d and 30d TVL change, market cap, category, audit links, and raise and hack counts, with up to 90 days of daily TVL on request (history_days). Fees and revenue are in compare_protocols. Partial when TVL, category or audits are missing; an unknown slug is an error (HTTP 404). Free tier.
descriptions.get_sentiment: Sentiment bucket (bullish, bearish, neutral or mixed) for an entity over 1d, 7d, 30d or 90d, rolled up hourly from the news BCA ingests and BCA's own articles: mention counts, mean score and the top bullish and bearish articles (drivers). Unseeded when no article mentions the entity in the window, stale when its newest window closed hours ago. Works without an API key.
descriptions.get_social_pulse: How crypto Twitter is talking about an entity: CT sentiment score (-1 to 1), label, mention trend, bull and bear points, narratives, and notable posts, from a live read. BCA analysis in its own words, with X post URLs as citations. Partial when the daily budget for live reads is spent or the source is down. Pro tier.
descriptions.get_fear_greed: Crypto Fear & Greed Index from Alternative.me: daily readings (value and classification), newest first, for up to 365 days. Works without an API key.
descriptions.get_ct_pulse: What crypto Twitter is saying over the last 24h: one-line takeaway, top stories, narratives heating or cooling, hard numbers with their source URL, and notable posts from credible accounts. Without a topic it returns the latest scheduled market snapshot and never makes a live read: stale (meta.status) once the snapshot is older than 6 hours, unseeded when none exists. With a topic it makes a live read. BCA analysis plus X post links, never reposted post text. Pro tier.
descriptions.get_x_signals: Breaking crypto stories from posts on X by vetted accounts (security researchers, exchanges, regulators, ETF analysts) plus an open keyword sweep. Each story: headline, summary, event type, the accounts and post URLs behind it, confidence, and whether onchain evidence was cited. latest_signal_at is the newest stored signal; an empty window answers stale when older signals exist (the sweep is behind or the lane is paused) and unseeded when none are stored. Pro tier.
descriptions.get_kol_consensus: Where credible crypto Twitter analysts, traders and researchers stand on the most-covered tokens, from the latest scheduled 24h snapshot: stance (bullish, bearish, mixed or neutral), bull and bear account counts, key points, and post links. Stale once the snapshot is older than 24 hours; unseeded for a token the snapshot does not cover (topic lists the tokens it covers). Pro tier.
descriptions.get_coverage_index: BCA Coverage Index: a recency-weighted count of BCA article mentions of the entity over 7d, 30d or 90d, recomputed every 4 hours. Unseeded when the entity had no mentions in the window. Pro tier. meta.status is unseeded when there is no measurement yet (data.value is then a placeholder), partial when some inputs were defaulted (meta.diagnostic.missing) and stale when the newest value is over 48 hours old. An unknown entity is an error (HTTP 404).
descriptions.get_narrative_strength: Narrative strength of an entity: its eigenvector centrality in the BCA co-mention graph over 7d, 30d or 90d, a gauge of whether its narrative is consolidating or fading. Unseeded when the entity is absent from the window's graph. Pro tier. meta.status is unseeded when there is no measurement yet (data.value is then a placeholder), partial when some inputs were defaulted (meta.diagnostic.missing) and stale when the newest value is over 48 hours old. An unknown entity is an error (HTTP 404).
descriptions.get_sentiment_velocity: Rate of change of an entity's sentiment (the smoothed derivative of its daily sentiment) over 7d or 30d: positive while sentiment rises, negative while it falls. Unseeded until the window holds two daily sentiment samples. Pro tier. meta.status is unseeded when there is no measurement yet (data.value is then a placeholder), partial when some inputs were defaulted (meta.diagnostic.missing) and stale when the newest value is over 48 hours old. An unknown entity is an error (HTTP 404).
descriptions.get_editorial_premium: Correlation of price return to coverage change, lagged -1 to +3 days, over 30d or 90d: whether BCA coverage leads price. Unseeded until at least 8 paired days of price and coverage exist. Pro tier. meta.status is unseeded when there is no measurement yet (data.value is then a placeholder), partial when some inputs were defaulted (meta.diagnostic.missing) and stale when the newest value is over 48 hours old. An unknown entity is an error (HTTP 404).
descriptions.get_kol_influence: KOL influence score (reach, engagement and historical pick accuracy) over 30d or 90d. Not available on the hosted API yet: its input, a private KOL roster, is not deployed there, so every call answers unseeded with that reason. Pro tier.
descriptions.get_risk_score: Composite risk score from 0 to 1, higher is riskier, built from regulatory, liquidity, team and audit inputs; components.sources names where each input came from. meta.status is partial when inputs are missing, listed in meta.diagnostic.missing (regulatory usually is), unseeded when none is available and stale when the score is over 48 hours old. An unknown entity is an error (HTTP 404). Starter tier.
descriptions.generate_due_diligence: Start a due diligence report on an entity covering tokenomics, team, audits, risk and narrative. Required: entity_slug. depth: light, standard or deep. focus is accepted but not applied yet: the report covers every section, and the answer lists focus under ignored_params. Async: returns job_id and status_url, and get_agent_job returns the report when it is done. Pro tier.
descriptions.generate_tokenomics_model: Simulate how emissions and unlocks move an entity's FDV over a horizon: horizon_days (rounded up to whole months, up to 120) and an optional unlock_shock_pct. scenarios is accepted but not modeled yet: the job simulates one unlock schedule and the answer lists scenarios under ignored_params. Async: returns job_id, status_url and the horizon_months used, and get_agent_job returns the model when it is done. Team tier.
descriptions.summarize_whitepaper: Fetch a whitepaper URL (PDF or HTML) and summarize it into one fixed structure: TL;DR, key points, tokenomics, team and risks, in the language asked for (default en). length other than standard is accepted but not applied yet (the answer lists it under ignored_params). Async: returns job_id and status_url, and get_agent_job returns the summary when it is done. Pro tier.
descriptions.translate_contract: Translate a smart contract between Solidity, Vyper, Move and Anchor. Required: code, source_language, target_language (the two must differ). Async: returns job_id and status_url, and get_agent_job returns the translation when it is done. Team tier.
descriptions.monitor_keyword: Save a keyword subscription: keyword plus an https webhook_url. The watcher is not built yet, so no webhook is sent: the answer comes back with meta.status unseeded and webhook_delivery not_active, and the job receipt under data. Required: keyword, webhook_url. Pro tier.
descriptions.get_agent_job: Poll an async agent job: kind, status (queued, running, done or failed), created, started and finished times, result when done and error when failed. monitor_keyword jobs answer unseeded with webhook_delivery not_active, since no watcher sends webhooks yet. Jobs are visible only to the key that started them. Pro tier.
descriptions.list_stablecoins: Stablecoins from DefiLlama in DefiLlama's order: peg type and mechanism, circulating supply in USD, price and chains, plus BCA's risk score and notes where BCA has rated the coin (null otherwise).
descriptions.list_nft_communities: Curated NFT communities: chain, website and X links, description and tags. Floor price, holders and editorial rank are not collected yet, so rows missing them answer partial (meta.diagnostic.missing).
descriptions.list_yields: Yield pools from DefiLlama with at least 100,000 USD TVL: project, chain, symbol, TVL, APY (base and reward), stablecoin and IL risk flags, plus BCA's risk tier where rated; highest APY first. Filter by chain and a minimum APY. Starter tier.
descriptions.list_aggregators: Swap, bridge and yield aggregators (curated: 1inch, Jumper, LI.FI, Rubic, ParaSwap and others) ranked by 30 day volume from DefiLlama, with 24h, 7d and 30d volume in USD; fees are not included. Rows without a DefiLlama volume (yield aggregators, unmatched names) answer partial. Required: kind (dex, bridge or yield).
descriptions.list_mcps: Directory of MCP servers (Blockchain Academics, well-known crypto servers and the reference servers) with vendor, transport, endpoint, auth requirement and official repository. Answers unseeded while the directory is empty.
descriptions.list_trading_bots: Curated trading bots (Telegram snipers, Solana terminals, copy trading tools): name, website, chains, pricing model, description and tags, sorted by name. Starter tier.
descriptions.list_vcs: Crypto VC directory: website, X, HQ, stages, sectors, AUM in USD and portfolio entities, filterable by focus and stage. Answers unseeded while no VC record is public. Starter tier.
descriptions.list_jobs: Live crypto jobs (1,300+ open roles at 50+ crypto companies: Coinbase, Binance, OKX, Ripple, Circle, Phantom, Uniswap...) collected every 6h from the companies' own job boards. Filter by role, remote, location, company, keyword. Apply links go to the company's own application page. Works without an API key.
descriptions.get_job: One crypto job in full: description, company, location, remote, salary when published, apply link, BCA job page URL. Errors once the role is filled. Works without an API key.
descriptions.search_grants: Live crypto, web3, AI and public-funding grants (200+ programs) with amounts, deadlines, eligibility and apply links. Verified against each funder's page weekly; expired rounds never returned. Soonest deadline first; page with offset. Works without an API key.
descriptions.get_grant: One grant program in full: funder, amount range, deadline, focus areas, geography, application complexity, summary, apply link, last verified date. Works without an API key.
descriptions.list_smart_contract_templates: Smart contract template catalog (OpenZeppelin references and BCA academy demos such as ERC20, ERC721, vesting, multisig, staking and airdrop): name, category, version, description and the canonical source_url. The code itself is not hosted.
descriptions.get_smart_contract_template: One smart contract template's catalog entry by slug: name, category, version, description and the canonical source_url. The code itself is not hosted, so the answer is partial with source_code missing.
descriptions.list_marketing_templates: Marketing and campaign templates (channel, format, tags). The bodies are still placeholders: such rows carry body_md null and body_status placeholder, and the answer is unseeded while every body is one. Starter tier.
descriptions.get_marketing_template: Fetch a specific marketing template by slug. Unseeded, with body_md null, while its body is still a placeholder. Starter tier.
descriptions.build_custom_indicator: Evaluate a custom formula over BCA primitives (coverage_index, sentiment_velocity, price_change_7d, risk_score, each taking an entity slug; operators + - * /) on 7 day values. Returns the computed value plus each function's component value. Unseeded when a value the formula needs is not computed yet; a formula the evaluator cannot parse is an error. Pro tier.
descriptions.get_tokenomics: Token supply data for an entity where BCA has a row: circulating, total and max supply, FDV, emission schedule, vesting cliffs, next unlock and 6 month dilution. Unseeded when there is no row (supply numbers are never invented); stale when the row could not be refreshed within 24 hours. Pro tier.
descriptions.get_audit_reports: Audits on file for an entity: BCA-reviewed audits with firm, date, report link, findings by severity and BCA's editorial score (averaged into bca_editorial_score). Rows with source defillama are audit links from DefiLlama protocol metadata: firm parsed from the link, no date or findings. Partial when only such links are on file; unseeded when nothing is on file. Starter tier.
descriptions.get_team_info: Team of an entity from BCA's entity dossier: founders (name, role, X and GitHub handles), doxx status and team size. Backgrounds and prior exits are not tracked, so the answer is partial and meta.diagnostic.missing names them, along with any tracked field the dossier leaves empty. Pro tier.
descriptions.get_roadmap: Roadmap milestones for an entity: title, target date, status and description, with a per milestone bca_verified flag for BCA's editorial fact check. Stale when no milestone was rewritten in 90 days (true of the current seed); unseeded when there are none. Starter tier.
descriptions.compare_protocols: Side by side comparison of 1 to 5 entities: live TVL with 1d and 7d change, fees and revenue (DefiLlama), market cap and FDV (CoinGecko), plus BCA's tokenomics, audits, team and indicator rows. Each row lists its empty sections under missing, tokenomics last refreshed over 30 days ago under stale, and why a live section is empty under unavailable; partial when any row misses a section or has stale tokenomics, unseeded when no row has data. Pro tier.
descriptions.check_rugpull_risk: Six check rugpull checklist with a weighted score: Etherscan source verification (when a contract address is on file), audit on file, team doxx status and the BCA risk score (passes below 0.5). LP lock and ownership renounce are not checked yet, and there is no honeypot test. Unknown checks are left out of the score and listed under missing (partial); unseeded when no check could be evaluated. Required: entity_slug. Pro tier.
descriptions.get_solana_ecosystem: Solana overview: DefiLlama chain TVL plus BCA's curated list of notable projects (Jito, Jupiter, Marinade, Raydium, Drift, Kamino, Tensor, Helium and others). Partial when DefiLlama has no TVL.
descriptions.get_l2_comparison: L2 side by side: DefiLlama TVL plus rollup kind and stack for Base, Arbitrum, OP Mainnet, zkSync Era, Starknet, Linea, Scroll, Mantle and Blast. Partial when a row has no DefiLlama TVL.
descriptions.get_bitcoin_l2_status: Bitcoin L2s (Stacks, Rootstock, BOB, Babylon, Merlin, Bitlayer): DefiLlama chain TVL and kind for each. Partial when a row has no DefiLlama TVL. Starter tier.
descriptions.get_ton_ecosystem: TON overview: DefiLlama chain TVL plus BCA's curated Telegram mini app and DeFi highlights (Notcoin, Hamster Kombat, STON.fi, DeDust, Tonstakers, tgBTC). Partial when DefiLlama has no TVL.
descriptions.get_compute_pricing: GPU rental prices in USD per GPU hour from Akash (live: min, max, average and median across providers, with availability), optionally filtered by GPU model. io.net and Render have no public pricing feed and are listed as pending, so the answer is partial.
descriptions.get_ai_crypto_metrics: Bittensor subnet metrics from Taostats; unseeded while the server has no Taostats key. Ritual and Prime Intellect are listed as not wired. Starter tier.
descriptions.track_pumpfun: pump.fun coins, trending by 24h volume or newest launches (mode), with price, FDV, liquidity, 24h volume and trades and links to pump.fun and GeckoTerminal, via GeckoTerminal. Up to 60 per call. Creator and social links are not in this source.
descriptions.track_bonkfun: bonk.fun (Solana meme launcher) trending launches. Not connected yet: answers unseeded until the bonk.fun feed is wired.
descriptions.check_memecoin_risk: Memecoin risk checks for a Solana mint (bundler, sniper and dev sell detection, LP burn, mint authority). Not computed yet: the analyzer is not built, so every call answers unseeded with the planned checks and a Solscan link to inspect the mint by hand. Required: mint. Pro tier.
descriptions.get_degen_leaderboard: Top PnL wallets on memes. Not built yet: needs a Solana wallet scoring pipeline, so every call answers unseeded. Pro tier.
descriptions.get_funding_rates: Perpetual funding rates for a symbol on Binance, Bybit and Hyperliquid (USDT pairs): each venue's raw rate with its funding interval (1, 4 or 8 hours), the rate on an 8 hour basis and annualized, mark price and next funding time, plus the mean of the 8 hour rates of the venues whose interval is known. dYdX is listed as pending, so the answer is partial. Pro tier.
descriptions.get_options_flow: Deribit options book for BTC, ETH or SOL: the top instruments by open interest (strike, expiry, call or put, mark IV, open interest and 24h volume), open interest per expiry and the put/call open interest ratio. limit and expiry narrow it. Lyra and Aevo are not wired. Pro tier.
descriptions.get_liquidation_heatmap: Liquidation heatmap (where leveraged positions get wiped) from CoinGlass. CoinGlass is not connected, so this answers unseeded today. Pro tier.
descriptions.get_exchange_flows: Net exchange inflows and outflows for an asset from CoinGlass. CoinGlass is not connected, so this answers unseeded today. Pro tier.
descriptions.predict_listing: Listing check and heuristic listing probability (0 to 1) for an entity on Binance, Coinbase or Upbit. An asset that already trades there (CoinGecko tickers) answers listed true with no probability. Otherwise a BCA editorial heuristic over coverage, narrative strength, risk, audit and team signals, with the components shown; not a forecast. Unseeded when the indicator inputs are missing; partial when the entity has no CoinGecko id or some inputs are unknown. Pro tier.
descriptions.track_narrative: Strength of a narrative (ai-agents, rwa, depin, modular, memes, bitcoin-l2, socialfi, gamefi): the mean BCA narrative strength score of its member entities over 7d, 30d or 90d, with each member's score. Recomputed every 4 hours; partial when some members have no score, unseeded when none does, stale when the scores are older than 8 hours. An unknown narrative is an error that lists the known ones. Starter tier.
descriptions.get_ai_agent_tokens: AI agent tokens (Virtuals Protocol, elizaOS (formerly ai16z), aixbt, Griffain, Zerebro, Bittensor, Artificial Superintelligence Alliance) with CoinGecko price, market cap, 24h volume and change, ranked by market cap.
descriptions.get_depin_projects: DePIN tokens (Helium, Render, Filecoin, Akash Network, IoTeX, DIMO, Hivemapper) with CoinGecko price, market cap, 24h volume and change, ranked by market cap.
descriptions.get_rwa_tokens: Real-world asset tokens (Ondo, Maple Finance, Centrifuge, Goldfinch, Pendle) with CoinGecko price, market cap, 24h volume and change, ranked by market cap. Starter tier.
descriptions.get_prediction_markets: Live prediction market odds from Polymarket and Kalshi, most traded first. Each market's outcomes is a list of {outcome, price}, the price being the implied probability (0 to 1). Takes a venue and a topic (crypto by default); partial, with meta.diagnostic.missing naming the venue, when a venue fails, has no markets or does not cover the topic.
descriptions.get_regulatory_status: Crypto regulation state for a country from BCA's curated table: overall status, regulators, key laws and notes, citing the regulator. Unseeded for a country BCA does not cover; partial while its key laws are not on file. Starter tier.
descriptions.track_sec_filings: Recent SEC EDGAR filings (form, filing date, document link) for the crypto-related listed companies BCA maps: MSTR, COIN, HOOD, MARA, RIOT, CLSK, BKKT and Galaxy Digital (ticker 'galaxy'). Any other ticker is an error (HTTP 404). Starter tier.
descriptions.get_mica_status: EU MiCA applicability by country, with national authorities: one country (ISO-2), or every Member State on file when country is omitted or EU (27 EU Member States, EEA states once seeded). Partial while some Member States have no row. A country outside the EU and EEA lists answers unseeded unless BCA has a reviewed row for it. Per project status is not tracked: entity_slug is ignored. Pro tier.
descriptions.get_tax_rules: Crypto tax rules for a jurisdiction: BCA's reviewed tax summary plus the tax authority's guidance link. Unseeded while no summary is on file (rates are never invented). Not tax advice. Starter tier.
descriptions.check_exploit_history: Hack history from DefiLlama's hacks dataset, newest first, amounts in USD: filtered by entity slug (whole word match on the hack name, or DefiLlama's parent protocol), and optionally by chain and minimum loss.
descriptions.check_phishing_domain: Checks a domain against MetaMask's phishing list (blocklist, allowlist and lookalikes of major domains) plus a pattern heuristic. Verdict: blocklisted, suspicious, allowlisted or clean_local. Partial when the list cannot be loaded; stale when the cached copy is over 6 hours old.
descriptions.get_bug_bounty_programs: Active Immunefi bug bounty programs, largest top bounty first, filterable by chain and minimum payout (USD). The Immunefi feed is off on the server for now, so this answers unseeded.
descriptions.scan_contract: Etherscan source check for an Ethereum contract: verified or not, contract name, compiler version, proxy flag and implementation address, license and a source preview. No owner lookup, honeypot test or exploit simulation. Required: address (0x EVM address). Starter tier.
descriptions.book_kol_campaign: Send a KOL campaign brief to BCA Studio. Required: contact_email, project_name, campaign_type (thread, video, space, podcast or hybrid) and budget_usd (500 to 2,000,000 USD). Needs an API key (the free tier is enough). Each brief alerts BCA Studio, who reply to contact_email by hand with a recommended KOL slate and quote (nothing is emailed automatically). Returns request_id, status and next_step.
descriptions.request_custom_research: Request a custom research report from BCA Research. Required: contact_email and topic (4 to 256 characters). Needs an API key (the free tier is enough). Each request alerts BCA Research, who reply to contact_email by hand with scope and a quote. Returns request_id, status and next_step.
descriptions.submit_listing: Submit a listing to a BCA directory: vcs, aggregators, trading_bots, mcps, nft_communities, jobs, stablecoins or trading_yields. Required: contact_email, directory, listing_name, listing_url and description (20 to 2,000 characters). Needs an API key (the free tier is enough). Each submission alerts the editors, who review it for fit and reply to contact_email by hand. Returns request_id, status and next_step.
descriptions.get_history_prices: Price history for a symbol from BCA's hourly price snapshots (USD price, market cap, 24h volume and change), up to 365 days: hourly up to 30 days and daily averages beyond, unless granularity says otherwise. Partial when days in the window have no snapshot, stale when the newest snapshot is over 3 hours old, unseeded when the window is empty.
descriptions.get_history_sentiment: Daily sentiment index for a symbol, up to 365 days, from BCA's nightly rollup of article (and, when collected, tweet) sentiment. tweet_count is null for days after the newest collected tweet, and the answer is partial for those days while the X reader is off; stale only when the rollup itself has stopped.
descriptions.get_history_correlation: Pearson correlation of a coin's daily price change against its daily BCA sentiment and, with peer, against the peer's daily price change, with the aligned daily series (each row carries peer_price_change_pct when peer is given). Partial below 7 paired days, for a flat series, or when an input is missing for part of the window.
descriptions.get_history_coverage: Daily BCA article coverage for an entity, up to 365 days: article count and average sentiment per day for the currency the entity maps to (ethereum to ETH, avalanche to AVAX). Unseeded when the entity has no tracked currency or no coverage in the window.
descriptions.list_entities: Browse the BCA entity registry (about 150 entities: chains, projects, people and tickers), most mentioned first. Filter by kind; page with offset. Partial when none of the listed dossiers has a summary or mentions yet.
descriptions.get_topic: Fetch one topic from the taxonomy: its live article count, child topics and up to 5 recent articles. Partial when no article is tagged with it yet. Works without an API key.
descriptions.search_academy: Full text search across academy lessons. Each hit has the course and lesson slugs, title, summary, publish date and site_url, the lesson's page on blockchainacademics.com (the slugs are not page URLs). Unseeded when nothing matches. Works without an API key.
descriptions.get_trending: Trending coins by mentions over 1h, 6h, 24h or 7d: article and tweet mention counts and average sentiment per symbol. No tweets are collected while the X reader is paused, so the answer is partial with tweets missing. Works without an API key.
descriptions.get_unified_feed: Chronological news feed from the RSS and Reddit sources BCA ingests, newest first.
descriptions.list_sources: The active news sources BCA ingests (RSS feeds, X accounts, Reddit) with type, URL and trust tier, by tier, plus whether BCA collects each one now (collecting, not_collecting_reason) and when it last stored an item from it (last_fetched_at). X accounts stay listed but answer collecting false (x_reader_off) while the X reader is off. Returns the whole registry by default (162 sources on 2026-11-01); has_more and next_offset say when to page.
descriptions.get_recent_stories: Recent stories: related articles from the last 24 hours clustered into one story each (deduplicated across sources), with any X signals attached. Works without an API key.
descriptions.list_memos: Browse public investment memos (paid fields redacted). No real one is published yet: the only public row is a test fixture, so this answers unseeded (fixture_rows_only) with the row flagged fixture. Starter tier.
descriptions.get_memo: Fetch a specific investment memo by slug. No real one is published yet: the only public row is a test fixture, so this answers unseeded (fixture_rows_only) with the row flagged fixture. Starter tier.
descriptions.list_theses: Browse public trade theses (entry, invalidation and targets at band granularity). No real one is published yet: the only public row is a test fixture, so this answers unseeded (fixture_rows_only) with the row flagged fixture. Starter tier.
descriptions.get_thesis: Fetch a specific trade thesis by slug. No real one is published yet: the only public row is a test fixture, so this answers unseeded (fixture_rows_only) with the row flagged fixture. Starter tier.
descriptions.get_social_signals: Social signals per currency from collected X posts: mentions, unique accounts, sentiment (average, min, max, label) and engagement, most mentioned first, with feed telling when tweets were last collected. Stale while the X reader is paused (unseeded when the window has no tweets); empty answers still carry data with results [].
descriptions.get_social_signals_detail: Social signal detail for one currency from collected X posts: mentions, unique accounts, sentiment, the top accounts by engagement (with last_tweet_at) and a sentiment breakdown. Unseeded when the window has no mentions, which is the usual answer while the X reader is paused.
descriptions.list_currencies: All tracked currencies with symbol, name and CoinGecko id, by symbol.
descriptions.get_currency_feed: Articles and collected X posts that mention one currency (by symbol), newest first, with sentiment. An unknown symbol is an error (HTTP 404).
